{{recipesummary|category=Casserole recipes|servings=8|time=40 minutes|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}}

'''Tuna rice casserole''' is a simple, quick-to-make meal that even kids can make!

==Ingredients==
* 2 cans (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:tuna|tuna]]
* 1 package (10 ounces / 280 g) frozen [[cookbook:peas|peas]], cooked
* 3 [[cookbook:cup|cup]]s cooked [[cookbook:rice|rice]]
* ¾ cup (6 ounces / 180 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) water
* 1 can (10 ounces / 280 g) [[cookbook:cheddar cheese|cheddar cheese]] [[cookbook:soup|soup]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F (200°C).
# In large bowl, combine tuna, peas, and rice, and mix well.
# In another large bowl, combine cheddar cheese soup and water.
# Place soup mixture in bowl with tuna mixture.
# Place combined mixture in greased [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated 400°F (200°C) [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 20 minutes.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Try adding 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]]s [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:onion|onion]] to first bowl before mixing.
* Tastes great with a [[cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] or two of ''Texas Pete'' [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]]!
*May substitute chopped chicken or turkey for the tuna.
